task.description:
Fix: ESCALATION events now include fired_late flag.

The SCH-05 implementation added fired_late detection to TIMER_FIRED events but the escalation timer branch (timer_type == "human_task_escalation") in processNextDueTimer was not updated. The ESCALATION event payload lacks fired_late, scheduled_fire_at, and actual_fire_at fields.

Changes needed in src/scheduler/scheduler.zig:

1. In processNextDueTimer (escalation branch, around line 131):
   Before calling fireEscalationTimerInTx, query NOW() as epoch microseconds (same pattern as the else branch):
   \\SELECT (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())::bigint * 1000000)::text
   Compute fired_late using isFiredLate(fires_at_epoch_us, actual_fire_at_us, poll_interval_us, is_startup_sweep).
   Then call fireEscalationTimerInTx with the extra params: fires_at_epoch_us, actual_fire_at_us, fired_late.

2. In fireEscalationTimerInTx signature (around line 184):
   Add params: fires_at_epoch_us: i64, actual_fire_at_us: i64, fired_late: bool
   Pass them through to appendEscalationEventInTx.

3. In appendEscalationEventInTx (around line 392):
   Add params: fired_late: bool, scheduled_fire_at_us: i64, actual_fire_at_us: i64
   Pass them to buildEscalationEventPayload.

4. In buildEscalationEventPayload (around line 563):
   Add params: fired_late: bool, scheduled_fire_at_us: i64, actual_fire_at_us: i64
   Append "fired_late":<bool>,"scheduled_fire_at":<i64>,"actual_fire_at":<i64> to the JSON output.
   The existing fields (timer_id, task_id, task_node_id, previous_assignee_type, previous_assignee_ref, reassign_to) must remain unchanged.

Validate: zig build must exit 0, zig build test must exit 0.
acceptance_criteria: ESCALATION event payload includes fired_late, scheduled_fire_at, actual_fire_at

result.summary: Fixed Category A (logic error) in scheduler.zig: ESCALATION event payload now includes fired_late, scheduled_fire_at, and actual_fire_at fields
